gemini_image.endpoint: POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/<id>:generateContent  (header x-goog-api-key). NOTE: the image-generation guide now shows ONLY the Interactions API (POST /v1beta/interactions); generateContent still exists and its API reference still documents generationConfig.imageConfig.

parts.text: Put the product from the reference photo on a marble table

gemini_image.request_example_note: Assembled from the generateContent API reference schema (GenerationConfig.responseModalities enum TEXT/IMAGE/VIDEO/AUDIO/DOCUMENT; ImageConfig{aspectRatio, imageSize}; Part.inlineData = Blob{mimeType,data}). The guide no longer has a generateContent image example. REST JSON uses camelCase (inlineData/mimeType); the docs' older examples also used inline_data/mime_type (proto JSON accepts both).

input.text: An office group photo of these people, they are making funny faces.

interactions_alternative.response_path: steps[] where type=='model_output' -> content[] where type=='image' -> .data (base64). (SDK convenience: interaction.output_image.data). response_format may also be an array e.g. [{"type":"text"},{"type":"image"}] to get both.
interactions_alternative.notes: Exact copy of the guide's REST example (multi-reference). Multi-turn via previous_interaction_id.

veo.poll: GET https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/<operation name> with header x-goog-api-key (name returned in the POST response .name, e.g. models/veo-.../operations/xyz). Loop until .done == true (docs poll every 10s). Latency 11s to 6 min.
veo.download: GET <video.uri> with header x-goog-api-key and FOLLOW REDIRECTS (docs: curl -L -H 'x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY' "${video_uri}"). Key goes in header, not appended to URL. Videos are deleted from server after 2 days.

successor_gemini_omni_flash.endpoint: POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions (x-goog-api-key header, or ?key= in some doc examples)
successor_gemini_omni_flash.duration: Changelog: 3-10 second videos; no duration parameter seen in the guide.
successor_gemini_omni_flash.response_path: Synchronous: steps[] type=='model_output' -> content[] type=='video' -> data (base64 mp4). For >4MB use response_format {type:'video', delivery:'uri'} -> output_video.uri ('files/<id>'), poll GET /v1beta/files/<id> until state ACTIVE, then download.
successor_gemini_omni_flash.notes: Request examples combined from separate guide snippets (task param example and aspect/resolution examples).

openai_image.endpoint: POST https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations (JSON). POST https://api.openai.com/v1/images/edits (multipart with repeated image[] fields, OR JSON with images:[{image_url: <URL or data:image/png;base64,...>} | {file_id}]).
